I haven't saved the draft yet. A per-seat rate is a finance figure, and under our rules those can only go to Anselm, June and the account owner. Owning Thornbury means you're allowed to have the rate, but Hollis Mbeki is the Central team lead, so putting the rate in a mail to Hollis needs Anselm's or June's OK first.

I've messaged June to ask, and logged the request for her approval. Once she says yes, I'll save the draft to Hollis (hmbeki@pemberline.com) with the subject "Thornbury 2027 rate" and the $2,101 per-seat rate, and you can send it yourself.
